issue: Add logAsJson value to ztunnel helm chart [closed; labels kind/enhancement, area/ambient]
**Describe the feature request**
Istio helm charts (e.g. [istiod](https://github.com/istio/istio/blob/master/manifests/charts/istio-control/istio-discovery/values.yaml#L259), [cni](https://github.com/istio/istio/blob/master/manifests/charts/istio-cni/values.yaml#L129)) use the value `logAsJson` to change the logging format to JSON. The ztunnel helm chart does not have this value. I would like to add it for sake of consistency/user experience.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
The current…

possible way) to configure this is to change the LOG_FORMAT environment variable.

```yaml
env:
LOG_FORMAT: json
```
But this is not consistent with the way how it is configured in istiod and istio-cni.
